summary: Phase 3 Onboarding (AiPrise SIMULATED mode) tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 NEW pytests PASS (test_phase3_onboarding.py) plus 65/66 regression PASS (1 pre-existing module-path failure in test_phase1.py is unrelated to Phase 3). Frontend: /apply public form renders all required data-testid fields, middleware whitelist works (no redirect to /login), form submits via POST /api/v1/onboarding/apply and routes to /apply/simulate with sim_kyb_ session id. Simulate page renders the DEV SIM badge + sim-approve/sim-reject/sim-review buttons. HOWEVER — clicking sim-approve does NOT navigate to /apply/status: the page stays on /apply/simulate because the `next=` query param embedded in the simulator URL points to the INTERNAL K8s cluster host (`finance-control-215.cluster-8.preview.emergentcf.cloud`) instead of the public preview URL. This is a backend bug in routes/onboarding.py::_public_base_url which uses request.url.netloc (K8s internal host) instead of honoring X-Forwarded-Host/X-Forwarded-Proto.

critical.issue: _public_base_url(request) returns the INTERNAL K8s cluster hostname (finance-control-215.cluster-8.preview.emergentcf.cloud) instead of the public preview origin. The internal host is baked into the simulator hosted_url's `next=` query param and also into the AiPrise callback_url. Result: the browser cannot navigate from /apply/simulate to /apply/status (the public URL is unreachable from the public browser); in LIVE mode the AiPrise webhook callback_url would also point at the unreachable internal host. Fix: use request.headers.get('x-forwarded-host')+x-forwarded-proto, OR introduce PUBLIC_BASE_URL env var and use that.

minor.issue: Returns 404 for unknown sessions but error path persists nothing to webhook_events (the doc is only persisted after _verify_and_log). Not breaking, but forensic visibility is limited.

ui_bugs.issue: After POST /apply/simulate succeeds, the redirect target (the `next=` URL) embeds the INTERNAL cluster hostname so window.location/router.push silently fails — user is stranded on the simulate page with the Approve button stuck in loading state ('...'). Net effect: /apply/status is never reached via the simulator flow on the preview URL.

integration_issues.issue: Breaks at simulate→status hop because backend-supplied `next` URL uses the internal cluster host. Backend pytest direct hits to /apply/simulate work fine; only the browser redirect breaks.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 backend is rock solid in SIMULATED mode (22/22 pytest GREEN). The single remaining issue blocks frontend E2E: the backend-baked `next=` URL on the simulator hosted_url uses the K8s INTERNAL host instead of the public preview origin. After the main agent fixes _public_base_url (likely 5-line change: prefer X-Forwarded-Host + X-Forwarded-Proto headers, fallback to request.url.netloc), retest by: (a) curl POST /api/v1/onboarding/apply on the public URL and confirm hosted_url's `next=` starts with https://finance-control-215.preview.emergentagent.com; (b) Playwright /apply → fill → submit → click sim-approve → expect /apply/status with green CheckCircle and 'approved'. /admin/compliance UI was not exercised in this iteration due to budget; backend compliance endpoints fully pytested (auth, role 403, decide, list, summary, kyc-cases).
rca of the issue: Backend onboarding.py defines `_public_base_url(req) = f"{req.url.scheme}://{req.url.netloc}"`. Behind the K8s ingress, FastAPI's `request.url.netloc` reports the internal upstream host (e.g. finance-control-215.cluster-8.preview.emergentcf.cloud) because the ingress rewrites the upstream Host header. The public origin only survives in `X-Forwarded-Host` + `X-Forwarded-Proto`. The bad internal URL is then concatenated into (1) the simulator hosted_url's `next=` query (breaks UI redirect to /apply/status on the public site) and (2) the AiPrise callback_url passed when creating verification sessions (will break the LIVE webhook delivery once AIPRISE_KYB_TEMPLATE_ID is configured). Reproduction: curl -s https://finance-control-215.preview.emergentagent.com/api/v1/onboarding/apply -X POST -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary '{...}' | jq -r .hosted_url — the `next=` value embeds the internal cluster host. Mitigation: replace _public_base_url with: `proto = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-proto', req.url.scheme); host = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-host', req.url.netloc); return f'{proto}://{host}'`. Optionally read PUBLIC_BASE_URL from env as override for tests.
